messages:
marie: Heads-up — onboarding opt-oral-13b v1. Putting a quick serving config together, want a fast pair of eyes before I submit a rollout.
marie: Weights + tokenizer locations:
marie: s3://redwood-models/opt-oral-13b/v1/weights.tar.gz
marie: s3://redwood-models/opt-oral-13b/v1/tokenizer.json
marie: Noticed tokenizer emits an extra leading '' token on some inputs which pushes token counts up by 1-3 tokens for many prompts.
jonas: thanks. can you paste the current serving config snippet you plan to use? small YAML or json is fine.
marie: sure — copy of the snippet I'm about to deploy:
marie: ```yaml
marie: model: opt-oral-13b
marie: version: v1
marie: continuous_batching:
marie:   enabled: true
marie:   max_batch_tokens: 4096
marie:   batch_latency_ms: 25
marie:   max_batch_size: 32
marie: cache_policy:
marie:   prefix_kv:
marie:     enabled: true
marie:     kv_ttl_secs: 86400
marie:     prefix_cache_size: 1000
marie: scheduler:
marie:   type: weighted-fair
marie:   max_concurrent_streams: 16
marie: limits:
marie:   max_input_tokens: 2048
marie:   max_output_tokens: 2048
marie:   token_margin: 32
marie: ```
akshay: quick notes:
akshay: - the tokenizer quirk increases effective tokens; token_margin 32 might be tight for some long prompts.
akshay: - for Dedicated GPUs I'd drop max_batch_tokens to 2048 or reduce max_batch_size to 16 to avoid OOM on older cards.
akshay: - consider setting `tokenizer.special_tokens_mapping` to strip the '' sentinel if safe.
infra-ci: config-lint: WARN: estimated_peak_batch_tokens = max_batch_tokens * max_batch_size = 131072 -> exceeds conservative limit 65536 for machine type g4dn.xlarge
infra-ci: config-lint: INFO: batch_latency_ms (25) within allowed range [10,100]
jonas: +1 to akshay. Also check scheduler weight for large requests — weighted-fair with 16 concurrent streams could cause head-of-line for low-latency paths.
jonas: Suggestion: set max_batch_tokens: 2048, max_batch_size: 16, token_margin: 64 (temporary) and keep prefix_kv enabled but reduce prefix_cache_size to 500 for initial canary.
sophie: I can run the canary on dedicated-us-west-2-1 after you update the config. I’ll validate latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and token regression on the eval set.
sophie: Also will test prompt variants that trigger the '' token to measure delta.
marie: ok updating now. new values: max_batch_tokens=2048, max_batch_size=16, token_margin=64, prefix_cache_size=500. pushing as canary.
deploy-bot: canary start scheduled by marie on pool dedicated-us-west-2-1 at 2026-03-17T15:40:30Z
sophie: running smoke tests now. ping me when done, will post p50/p95/p99 and any decode errors.
marie: @jonas @akshay can you skim the updated snippet and approve? I’ll open the rollout once sophe gives green on latency and token regressions.
jonas: will review in ~30m.
akshay: lgtm but please include a short note in the PR about the tokenizer workaround so model ops can revisit later.
marie: will do. thanks all :)
